definitions.bannerHpSaved: Each fixed recorded action replayed with own holy-banner buffs removed only; signed difference in immediate clipped own-unit HP loss. Includes own attacks/counterattacks and automatic effects in END_TURN. Each action resets to its actual recorded pre-state, so local effects do not simulate a buff-free whole game. Per-cast attribution uses the last cast that actually assigned the recipient buff; any indirect contribution remains in the action total.
definitions.unused: At the end of own turn, a tracked paid unit retains attack readiness and has a visible legal positive-damage attack or siege target. Legality does not establish that taking the action is tactically better.
definitions.incomePreview: Native yield-function estimate at the sampled state, not a separately attributed cash ledger.

limits: Threat checks use only enemies visible before the recorded move/cast, fixed enemy positions, native per-shot damage and no assumed hidden information. They omit enemy movement, multi-shot bursts, focus fire and future turn changes.
A legal local alternative with lower visible exposure is a positioning opportunity, not proof of a better whole-game strategy or win.
Controlled mechanic arenas use native definitions unchanged on flat terrain. They are diagnostic calculations, not extra outcome samples.
